metric_definition.cosine: Arithmetic mean of paired MiniLM cosine over all scorable public agent-message references, assigning zero to missing or wholly unknown predictions. Partial-unknown predictions retain their archived raw cosine. Task status, discarded messages, and unscorable references are excluded. Not percent accuracy.
metric_definition.classification: Use the historical prediction status when an original classification exists; verify it against the hashed historical report. Otherwise, only an explicitly fresh decoder-config report may use its archived raw-parser status. No new semantic classification is performed.
metric_definition.denominator: All scorable public agent-message references, including abstentions assigned zero.
metric_definition.coverage: Non-abstaining predictions / scorable references; separate from cosine denominator.
metric_definition.partial_unknown: Retain the archived raw cosine; a tentative/structural guess is not evidence of correct decipherment.
